sources: TM 1-1520-237-10 (operator's manual, UH-60A / UH-60L / EH-60A), figures 2-1, 2-2, 2-4, 2-5, 2-7, 2-8, 2-9, 2-10, 2-13, 2-14, 6-1, 6-9, 6-11 and chapter 7 performance examples. TM 55-1520-237-23-5 (maintenance manual, 1989) figures 11-22, 11-23, 11-27, 11-34, 11-35 for pedals, floor boots and cyclic stick, and 11-40, 11-41 for the collective covers and boots. TM 1-1520-237-23 (2006) work packages 0215 00 and 0216 00 for the glare shield, knee protectors and panel mounting. TM 1-1520-237-23 (2006) work package 0231 00 figures 7, 9, 14, 24, 27, 28 for the crew seats. TM 1-1520-237-23 (2006) work packages 0201 00, 0203 00, 0204 00, 0206 00, 0207 00 and 0208 00 for the cockpit door's inside face (jettison gear, window doublers, vent window, inside handle, rods and latches). See notes/SOURCES.md.
source_grade: A for the outside shape, principal dimensions, cabin and flight performance (official dimensioned drawings and charts). B for fittings, panel layout, hub hardware and seat construction (inferred from the manual's undimensioned illustrations).
status: Parametric geometry recipe (Blender Python) with two LODs, doors, rotors and controls that move; flight model checked against four manual torque points; synthesised sound. Not yet done from an illustrated parts breakdown: fastener counts and exact panel lines are inferred.
